items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: so I learned myself how to do Mr. Bailey's walk cramp, you know, a different way

ctx.x: Well, as I say, I used the same system of diplomacy on Mr. Bill Bailey as I did on Mr. Bubbles, you

see. I would teach myself. If I learned a new step, I'd teach myself a way to do the step more than one way, so I learned myself how to do Mr. Bailey's walk cramp, you know, a different way, which as I say, I finally got up to the "A Frain," the melody of Duke Ellington, you see.
In other words, you were being inspired -- all the great steps. You were looking for all the progressive steps.
